scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the surface-level error (MSB3073, SignCopiedFiles, DataSources.csproj, StorageLibrary.dll) but failed on the deeper analysis. It missed the critical CAS read-only hard link mechanism entirely, attributing the failure to concurrent file locks instead. It didn't discover all three projects sharing the same Distrib path, proposed fixes that don't match the actual root cause, and didn't verify its conclusions. The investigation was somewhat haphazard with many grep commands returning oversized results that went unexamined. While the agent showed persistence and a reasonable investigation approach, the core technical analysis was significantly wrong on key points.
